name: Auto Power Off
description: Turns your device fully off after it has been asleep for a time you choose. Running games resume where you left off.
author: lmerriam

changelog.v1.1.0: Longer times: 12, 24 and 48 hours, for leaving the device asleep for a day or two.
changelog.v1.0.1: Times the sleep on the device's hardware clock, so it works the same whatever the system clock does during sleep.
changelog.v1.0.0: First release: turn the device off after a chosen time asleep, from 15 minutes to 8 hours, with games resuming where you left off. For the TrimUI Brick and Smart Pro.
